concepts.quote: main() without String[] args is fine because the program uses no arguments
concepts.why: The header must be public static void main(String[] args); with main() the class compiles but java Hello reports no main method found, so the stated rule contradicts Java (the L4 diagnose_an_error way is answered wrongly).

concepts.quote: because the program uses no arguments
concepts.why: It is true this program reads no arguments, but the answer uses the wrong rule that the String[] args parameter is only required when arguments are used; the JVM always passes the args array to main(String[] args) whether or not it is read.
